integrity.data_origin: explicit synthetic cyclic site-label arrangements; no empirical field data
integrity.proof_type: elementary exact combinatorics with complete small-site classification
integrity.reproducibility: standalone Python standard-library verifier and exact certificate

scientific_limitations: Sites form a cycle and each has exactly one taxon; not a theorem for arbitrary spatial mosaics or nonperiodic boundaries.
The near-one variance gap is a sharp range only within the dominant-taxon/two-singleton family.
The finite n<=5 statement requires knowledge of the complete mean curve at every window length.
Literature coverage is not exhaustive; independent bibliographic verification has not been performed.
title: Six-site threshold for hidden richness risk in cyclic species–area curves
